question: By which ritual paths are these practices said to be accomplished or declared?
premises: Accomplishment is associated with the right-hand path.
These practices are also declared in relation to the left-hand path.
The verse contrasts or pairs the two paths.
inference: These practices are accomplished by the right-hand path and declared in relation to the left-hand path.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between saṃsiddhā and prakīrttitāḥ is compressed.
plain_english: By the right-hand path they are accomplished, and by the left-hand path these are declared.
